Open a missed question in the Query tab: which of the two sentences made it into the context?
The second sentence of an answer never matches the question on its own. It has to arrive next to the first one.
A chunk of 200 characters sometimes holds both sentences and often cuts them apart. A window does not depend on where the boundaries fall.
With one sentence per chunk, a window of one neighbour on each side sends the sentence before and after every hit. One hit is usually enough.
